To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
ADAMTS5 is the most important aggrecanase in OSM-stimulating cartilage, whereas HYAL-2 mediates hyaluronidic aggrecan degradation.

ADAMTS5 is the most active aggrenase and is responsible for the OSM-specific cleavage of aggrecan; ADAMTS5 activity is modulated by the ancillary domains; and HYAL-2 mediates OSM-induced aggrecan release.
OSM is a unique catabolic cytokine, as it is the only one that can mediate aggrecanolysis and release in the absence or presence of proteolysis.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of the aggrecanse and hyaluronase involved in the catabolic process induced by OSM.
the identification of the aggrecanolysis and the hyaluronan-degrading enzymes that are involved in the breakdown of the cartilage matrix by OSM.
the identification and characterization of aggrecanolysis and aggrecan release, and the mechanisms by which aggrecanolysis occurs in cartilage.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the aggrecanase activity of ADAMTS-5, but not that of ADAMTS -4, is responsible for the unique OSM-specific aggrecan degradation pattern in the chondroitinsulfate (CS)-2 domain.
OSM-induced aggrecanolysis is mediated by ADAMTS5 cleavage of the aggrecanolysis sites, whereas aggrecan release is mediated by HYAL2 cleavage of hyaluronan.
ADAMTS4 is the most inducibly expressed aggrecanase, whereas ADAMTSS is the most abundantly expressed aggrecanases.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
OSM is an effective cytokine in inducing aggrecanolysis and hyaluronolysis.
ADAMTS5 is the most active aggrenase in OSM-stimulatied cartilage, but that HYAL2 is the predominant enzyme mediating hyaluronan release.

ADAMTS5 is a more potent aggrecanase than ADAMTS4, and the C-terminal thrombo-spondin domain of the aggrecanolysis domain of the enzyme plays a crucial role in determining its substrate selectivity and activity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
ADAMTS5 is the most abundant aggrenase in cartilage, and it is the most active in generating the OSM-specific aggrecanase cleavage site.
ADAMTS5 is the most potent aggrecanase in the cartilage, whereas ADAMTs4 is the most inducibly expressed.
the catabolic cytokine OSM is unique among the catabolic agents in its ability to induce both early and robust aggrecanolisis through the action of the aggrecnanase ADAMTS5.
